messages:
alex: Heads-up — small but reproducible NDCG drop (~1.8%) when we started L2-normalizing candidate embeddings before the reranker scoring. Seen on dev holdout. Could be formatting change interplay.

maria: Hmm, do you mean we changed normalization in embed pipeline or in reranker input? link?

alex: normalization moved to embed service (embed v2) last week. Example eval log: https://ci.internal/logs/embed-v2-deploy-1743

devon: quick question: are candidates tokenized differently (html vs text)? that bit shows up in earlier threads.

alex: good call — seems some docs in dataset have html metadata preserved. I suspect combined effect: normalized dense + extra tokens from tags shifting dot products.

maria: can we run ablation: (A) normalize+raw html (B) normalize+strip html (C) no normalize+strip html. Also track MRR and NDCG@10 and candidate order diffs.

jin: I can run offline sweep tonight. what config do you want? give me the eval script + sample size.

alex: sample 20k queries (same holdout). use bootstrap 1000 for CI. eval script snippet:
```
python eval_rerank.py --queries holdout_2025_12k.json --candidates candidates_v1.json \
  --reranker-model rerank-xxl:v3 --embed-normalize true|false --strip-html true|false \
  --metrics ndcg@10 mrr --bootstrap 1000
```

maria: also capture candidate cosine vs dot, and add a field "candidate_html_preserved" in outputs so we can slice by docs with tags.

devon: note quantized reranker may amplify effects — can we run vfp32 and int8 for the top configs?

alex: yes add `--model-precisions fp32,int8` to the script. I suspect normalization interacts with quant rounding.

jin: started job: job id ej-4823. I'll post results here when done.

eval-bot: job ej-4823 completed — summary CSV uploaded: https://ci.internal/evals/ej-4823.csv

sam: quick peek: NDCG drop concentrated on queries with short candidate lists and html-heavy docs. probably token boundary shift.

maria: if that holds, short-term fix = strip html in candidate prep; long-term = normalize on reranker side (after candidate tokenization) so quantization sees same inputs.

alex: agreed. If ablation shows normalize-before-tokenize causes drift, we'll flip embed service back and add regression test.

jin: results: A(normalize+raw): ndcg@10 0.823, B(normalize+strip): 0.840, C(no-normalize+strip): 0.842. MRR similar pattern. I'll attach full CSV.

alex: thanks — that's pretty clear. Action items: 1) Sam to add strip-html in candidate preproc for prod 2) Maria to add regression eval for embed-normalize toggle 3) Ops to schedule small canary for prod flip.

sam: on it. PR coming in ~2h. :thumbsup:

maria: I'll add eval watch and set alert if ndcg delta>0.5% on holdout.

alex: perfect. closing the loop once canary done.
